text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Rule number one of a mentor! Provide what 
is truly necessary!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Rule number one of a mentor! Provide what 
is truly necessary!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Principles of Leadership" echoed 
through the air. Followed by straight 
punches cutting through the empty wind—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what on earth is happening? The story 
goes back a few days...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I heard all about how Pandora-san and 
Eye-san have been doing lately!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds like they're working hard, wishing 
they could do something for Ai-san's 
future."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I told my best friend a little bit about 
Pandora-san. And then, she said she wanted 
to speak with you directly."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"If you're interested, go pay her a visit! 
It's that girl you know well, who's also 
involved in training the Junior Club♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —From Line Craft

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's a photo too! Wait, this "best 
friend" is—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Look, it's Cesario-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario—a contemporary of Rhein Kraft and 
the first Japanese Umamusume to win an 
American GⅠ, the American Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While she currently refrains from entering 
many races... she possesses world-class 
talent, as well as an extraordinary 
passion for nurturing the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Cesario-chan is super 
knowledgeable about that kind of stuff, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, let's go ask her real quick~♡ Thanks, 
Kuu-chan senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, full of bounce and cheer☆, I gave 
a brief explanation of what happened to 
ask Cesario for guidance.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I know the feeling. Students, 
underclassmen... they're so adorable, 
aren't they?♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
They're looking towards the future with 
such sparkling eyes, it makes me want to 
do something for them.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, exactly! ♡ So, what should I 
be doing right now?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's pretty much as expected. In 
that case—first off, one thing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I can't approve of the current approach.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Fweh? A-All of a sudden, Cesario-chan is 
in "on" mode!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win a G1 so I can be an example 
for her." This one is fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"‘Give homemade sweets.’ ‘Buy shoes.’ 
‘Cheer on her training’—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Would that sort of thing really be 
beneficial for her?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
B-But, but, but! Both of those are things 
my Trainer did for me too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Every single one made me happy, so I 
thought... Ai-chan would be happy with 
them too... That's what I thought, but..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen, you and Ai-san are different. 
Your Trainer gave you what you needed 
precisely because it was for you."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To begin with... guiding an Umamusume is 
different from guiding a human.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What is it you should be doing right now? 
What is it you need to show her? Think 
about it one more time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Something I should show...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the ribbon I bought yesterday that'll 
look super cute on you, Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will take charge of you for 
a while. And I shall teach you the true 
mindset of a leader!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fusaichi Pandora was to study 
under Cesario for a while to learn what it 
means to be a leader.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Rule number one hundred of a mentor...! 
First, polish... your own... self...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Bwehhh~! I'm beat! I'm exhausted from 
acting so serious all the time...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
After a 10-minute break, I need your help 
coaching the juniors. Don't you dare be 
late!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeeees... Waaah, I wanna go home 
already.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Still, you did very well, 
Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...! O-Offthelio-chan~! Waaah, I missed 
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared some drinks over there, so 
please, feel free to enjoy them during 
your break♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Skillfully manipulated by Cesario's 
dual-natured carrot-and-stick approach, my 
trainer apprenticeship continued on."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just skim through it! Think 
about what it means and put it into your 
own words!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, but there's way too many! "The 
Horseshoe Vow: Umamusume Guidance 
Outline," "The Running Spirit Guide," and 
"Guiding Hoofprints" even has three 
volumes...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This recipe is based on sports nutrition 
and is rich in essential amino acids. 
Today, I'll make this as a supplementary 
meal.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, that's insane amount! Better get it 
done quick~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, all cleaned up. Being an instructor 
is tough work, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Oops! Hey, you guys over there! Stop 
looking at your phones and pack it up, 
pack it up!”

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Sorry! But that thing is just 
within reach!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: 『The Japanese superstar, Cesario!』

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaa!! So freakin' cooool!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Could that mean... Cesario-chan's 
American Oaks?

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That's right!!! From that legendary race!!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We love it so, so much! We saw it live, 
and we're still rewatching it over and 
over even now.

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right! And every time we see it, we remind 
each other that one day, we'll take on the 
world just like Cesario-sensei!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So――excuse me, Pandora-sensei! Can I go 
run a lap around the track?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—H-Hey! You asked if it was okay, but 
you're already running!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reckless and unpolished, yet running with 
all their might, they sprinted across the 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, those girls are fast. And like, 
aren't they super good at accelerating?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without slowing down, she dashed forward 
with her eyes sparkling brighter and 
brighter, a dazzling sight to behold—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
... "You'll turn into Cesario-sensei," 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Fusaichi Pandora didn't stop 
her, gazing at the dazzling sight of her 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. Perhaps it's about time I 
tell you the true essence of being a 
guide."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We've both been acting as mentors these 
past few days, but... What do you think is 
the foremost duty of a guide?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~~... There's coaching ability, 
knowledge, and lots of other things on my 
mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right! And every time we see it, we remind 
each other that one day, we'll take on the 
world just like Cesario-sensei!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Maybe... some respectable track record?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Heh... You're half right.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"—Listen well. The sight of an Umamusume 
dashing forward can sometimes ignite 
someone's heart and create an entirely new 
path."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And no memory or video can surpass the 
drama right before your eyes. In other 
words, what you need to do is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's to reflect her shining figure on the 
turf before her very eyes—in her world.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Neither your Trainer nor I—having stepped 
away from the competitive world—can do 
this. This is something only the current 
you can achieve."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I do not win merely to serve as an 
example. Video materials would suffice for 
that.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You must capture their hearts and guide 
them.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...This is precisely what a guide ought 
to do most."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I get it. I get it, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah...―― Me, take on Ai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Do not flinch. Press forward with 
strength. If you truly wish to guide 
Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Yeah, that makes sense...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ………… Thanks, Cesario-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having learned a major lesson, Cesario's 
training came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Win, capture their hearts, and lead 
them", huh...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...Well, there's no choice but to do it. 
For Ai-chan's sake.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, never mind!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I just thought, 'Man, that looks tough,' 
that's all! Though, knowing that kind of 
thing gives you strength—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like the dazzling coolness of dreaming, 
and the strength to run while believing in 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That stuff is still right here with me! 
It's still pumping me up!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Kuu-chan-senpai taught me too, so...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmh, alright... let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To guide Almond Eye. To showcase the 
brilliance of the genius, Fusaichi 
Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They pledged together to seize victory at 
their next goal, the glorious GⅠ race: the 
Victoria Mile.
